scripts.gen: cargo run -q -p server --bin openapi -- openapi.json && vp exec openapi-typescript openapi.json --output src/schema.gen.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- openapi.json src/schema.gen.ts && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- openapi.json src/schema.gen.ts)"
